youtube_description:
#unitedstatesrepresentativedistrict10florida #drushajain #nopartyaffiliation #uscongress
This is a short video of Dr. Usha Jain who is running for Congress. "I am Dr. Usha Jain, and I am running for congress as a candidate for the people and not a party (no party affiliation). I believe, in order to be your representative, I am an able, stable, and dependable leader who will inspire and would fight for fairness and equality in our healthcare system, our judicial system, and our education system. I am that leader because I have been a doctor in this area for the past 36 years and I know the struggles of people who live in my district. I lived them myself and for that reason, I am the right messenger. I will be the voice for the people in Washington to make changes:
In the health care system, the doctor is in charge, not the insurance company. Patients should not be restricted to a list of doctors and they should be allowed to see any doctor of their choice
 . Your talent, volunteering, and financial support will help the part of this movement.
